Messages.Author: emime
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

The Vampire: The Eternal Struggle Grand Prix Tour 2023 has a stop in Belgium this year! Join the fray to achieve automatic qualification for Day 2 of the European Championship and supreme swag!

This is the official announcement of the

*** Brussels Grand Prix 2023 ***

Date: Sunday, July 16, 2023
Registration: 11:30
First round starting time: 12:00
Expected finishing time: 21:00

Type of Event: Grand Prix (see the  tournament rules )

Being a Grand Prix, the use of proxy cards is  not allowed. See the  instructions for the use of cards from printable V:EKN expansion sets.

Number of rounds: 3 + final
Time limit per round: 2 hours

Address of Event:
The Outpost
Rue de la Tribune 8
1000 Bruxelles
Belgium
Tel. +32 (0)2 2180400

(note that it is not allowed to bring your own food and drinks into the shop)

Entry fee: 10 euros

*** Pre-registration ***

Pre-registration is very useful to ensure appropriate prize support and a timely start of the tournament. If you intend to participate, please sign up as soon as possible by replying to this thread - or join the  Facebook event .

*** How to reach ***

By train: The Outpost is situated less than 10 minutes walking from Brussels Central Station (Gare Centrale).
If you arrive from Paris/London, you will end up at Brussels South Station (Gare du Midi). From there, take the metro line 2 or line 6, direction "Simonis (Elisabeth)", get off after about 8 minutes at the stop "Madou", then walk 5 minutes to the Outpost.

By car: parking is free around the Outpost on Sundays.

We hope to see many of you in Brussels on July 16th!

Cheers,
Emiliano

PS And for an even more memorable V:TES weekend, do not miss the  Belgian Limited Championship the day before!

Emiliano "Sans Terre" - Wandering Player - Prince of Brussels

Loot update!

Every participant in the V:TES Brussels GP 2023 will receive several promo cards, including the special Grand Prix version of Tier of Souls, the “Belgian version” of Bum’s Rush and the EC 2022 promo Maila (courtesy of Black Chantry), plus one copy of each vampire from the new Echoes of Gehenna and Shadows of Berlin packs and additional promos!

And of course, more loot from Black Chantry and Ultra PRO is ready for the winner and the finalists… and even an additional home made surprise!

NB; The entry fee for the GP is confirmed to be 10 euros.
